It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|5000}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{tprice|furniture}}. It can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|winter}}. It can also be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart|Traveling Merchant]]'s shop at the [[Festival of Ice]] for {{Price|5000}} or from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] for {{Price|5000}}.
